## Apply

### Exercise 21

1. Start with the latest exercise solution
2. Fit PCR to the leads qualification data, including tuning the number of principal components using 5-fold cross-validation (start a code cell with `#| warning: false` to suppress warnings)
3. Tune the classification cutoff separately using 5-fold cross-validation
4. Evaluate model performance on the test data using both tuned hyperparameters
5. Refit the model on the complete dataset and bootstrap interval estimates
6. Submit both your Quarto document and your code, output, and interpretations as a single PDF on Canvas

### Milestone 21

Apply PCR to your project and compare it to penalized regression and logistic regression using cross-validated predictive or decision-theoretic fit. What is your best model so far?
